AGENDA
  GLENDALE ARTS AND CULTURE COMMISSION
  COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  613 E. Broadway, 2nd Floor
  Glendale, CA 91206
Meetings are broadcast live on Glendale TV, viewable on Spectrum Cable, channel 6, and AT&T U-
verse, channel 99. Meetings are also streamed live in high definition (HD) on the city's webpage,
glendaleca.gov/live, on YouTube.com/myglendale, and on Apple TV, Roku, and Amazon Fire
devices using a free app called Screenweave and choosing “Glendale TV” from the menu. Meetings
are also archived on the City Website for viewing anytime at glendaleca.gov/agendas. Call (818)
548-4013 for program schedules. DVDs of the proceedings are available for purchase in the City
Clerk's Office. For public comments and questions during the meeting, call (818) 937-8100. Public
comments on a specific agenda item will be taken when that agenda item is discussed. If you have
any question about matters on the agenda, or requests for assistance, please contact the Library,
Arts and Culture Department, at (818) 548-2030, during regular business hours.
  PLEASE TURN OFF CELLULAR PHONES WHILE INSIDE THE MEETING LOCATION
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) of 1990, auxiliary hearing aids, sign
language translation, and Braille transcripts are available upon request. Assisted listening devices
are available same-day upon request. At least 48 hours (or two business days) notice is required for
requests regarding sign language translation and Braille transcription services. All documents
related to open session items on this agenda that are received less than 72 hours prior to this
meeting, and are public records, will be available for review in the Office of the City Clerk, 613 E.
Broadway, RM 110, Glendale, CA 91206.
Translation services are provided for meetings through the use of bilingual staff for speakers who
wish to utilize the service as available. Speakers should state their request by contacting the City
Clerk’s office at (818) 548-2090, at least 24 hours prior to the scheduled meeting. Please specify
the language for which you require translation. The exclusive use of City provided interpreters is not
required and persons are welcome to use their own interpreter or speak in their native language.
  AUGUST 18, 2022 AT 2:00 PM

REVISED
  - Item 3a was added.
  - Item 6a: City-Wide Public Art Landmarks RFQ #2 (LeBasse Projects) was removed.

  1.  REGULAR BUSINESS AGENDA – 2:00 PM
  Roll Call
  a. Report of Recorder, re: Posting of Agenda. The Agenda for the August 18, 2022
  Regular Meeting of the Glendale Arts and Culture Commission was Posted on
   August 15, 2022 on the Bulletin Board Outside City Hall.

2.  CONSENT ITEMS (Including Minutes)
  The following are routine and may be acted upon by one motion. Any member of the
  Commission or the audience requesting separate consideration may do so by making such
  request before motion is proposed.
  a. Minutes of the July 14, 2022 Special Meeting of the Arts and Culture Commission.
  b. Minutes of the July 21, 2022 Regular Meeting of the Arts and Culture Commission.

3.  INTRODUCTIONS AND PRESENTATIONS
  a. New Staff: Maryl Fleisher, Marketing Program Supervisor
  b. Library, Arts & Culture Events – Presented by Jennifer Fukutomi-Jones, Principal

  Arts & Culture Administrator

4.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
  Discussion is limited to Items NOT a Part of this Agenda. Each Speaker is Allowed 5 Minutes.
  Members of the Glendale Arts and Culture Commission may Question or Respond to the
  Speaker, but there will be no Debate or Decision. The Matter may be Referred to Staff
  Through the Commission Chair for Investigation and Report.

 5.  ACTION ITEMS
  a. I.D.E.A. (Inclusion. Diversity. Equity. Antiracism.) Plan
  1. Motion to approve and adopt the I.D.E.A. (Inclusion. Diversity. Equity. Antiracism.)
  Plan by The Aspire Group.
  b. Sponsorship Opportunity – Glendale International Film Festival
  1. Motion approving (1) the funding of a proposal by Glendale Arts to provide arts
  programming associated with the Glendale International Film Festival, and (2) the
  sponsorship of the Glendale International Film Festival, in an amount not to exceed
  $5,000 from the 2022-2023 Work Plan.

6.  DISCUSSION ITEMS
  a. 2022-2023 Work Plan Progress Updates
  1. CITY-WIDE ARTS
  i. Art Happens Anywhere – Projects Culmination
  ii. Mural Ordinance – Update
  iii. Creative Crosswalks – Update
  2. NEIGHBORHOOD ARTS – No Update
  3. PERFORMING ARTS – No Update
  4. ARTS AND CULTURAL EVENTS – No Update
  5. MARKETING AND COMMUNICATIONS
  i. Public Relations Firm - RFP

7.  COMMISSION/STAFF COMMENTS

8.  WRITTEN COMMUNICATIONS
 9.  ADJOURNMENT
  The next Regular Meeting of the Glendale Arts and Culture Commission is Thursday,
  September 15, 2022, at 2:00 PM in City Council Chambers (2nd Floor) – 613 E. Broadway.

CITY OF GLENDALE
  ARTS and CULTURE COMMISSION
  Minutes of Regular Meeting

  Thursday, August 18, 2022 at 2:00 p.m.
1.  ROLL CALL
  •  The meeting was called to order on August 18, 2022 at 2:08 p.m.
  •  Present: Commissioner Tufenkian, Vidor, Vice Chair Viar, Chairperson Yank
  •  Absent: Commissioner Zadorian
  •  The Agenda for the August 18, 2022 Regular Meeting was posted on August 15, 2022 on the Bulletin
  Board outside City Hall.

2. CONSENT ITEMS (INCLUDING MINUTES)
  The following are routine and may be acted upon by one motion. Any member of the Commission or the
  audience requesting separate consideration may do so by making such request before motion is proposed.
  a. Minutes of the July 14, 2022 Special Meeting of the Arts and Culture Commission and Minutes of
  the July 21, 2022 Regular Meeting of the Arts and Culture Commission.
  Moved:  Commissioner Viar
  Seconded: Commissioner Tufenkian

  Ayes:  Commissioners Tufenkian, Vidor, Vice Chair Viar, Chairperson Yank
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  Commissioner Zadorian
  Abstain:  None

3. INTRODUCTIONS & PRESENTATIONS
  a. Library, Arts & Culture Events – Presented by Jennifer Fukutomi-Jones, Principal Arts & Culture
  Administrator
  • Maryl Fleisher, Marketing Program Supervisor of the Glendale Library Arts & Culture
  department introduced herself to the Commission.
  • Ms. Fukutomi-Jones gave an overview of current and upcoming events at Glendale Library, Arts
  & Culture locations.

4. ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
  Discussion is limited to Items NOT a Part of this Agenda. Each Speaker is Allowed 5 Minutes. Members of
  the Arts and Culture Commission may Question or Respond to the Speaker, but there will be no Debate or
  Decision. The Matter may be Referred to Staff Through the Commission Chair for Investigation and Report.
  • Mr. Meek suggested art in the alleys around Glendale.

5. ACTION ITEM(s)
  a. I.D.E.A. (Inclusion. Diversity. Equity. Antiracism.) Plan
  1. Motion to approve and adopt the I.D.E.A. (Inclusion. Diversity. Equity. Antiracism.) Plan by The
  Aspire Group.
  That the Arts and Culture Commission hereby approves and adopts the I.D.E.A. (Inclusion.
  Diversity. Equity. Antiracism.) Plan by The Aspire Group, as more fully outlined in the August 18,
  2022 Report by the Library, Arts & Culture’s Principal Arts & Culture Administrator.

  Moved:  Commissioner Viar
  1
   Seconded: Commissioner Vidor

  Ayes:  Commissioners Tufenkian, Vidor, Vice Chair Viar, Chairperson Yank
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  Commissioner Zadorian
  Abstain:  None

b. Sponsorship Opportunity – Glendale International Film Festival
  1. Motion to approve (1) the funding of a proposal for the Glendale International Film Festival to
  provide arts programming associated with the Festival, and (2) the sponsorship of the Glendale
  International Film Festival in an amount not to exceed $5,000 from the 2022-2023 Work Plan.
  •  Nina Crowe of Glendale Arts gave a brief presentation of her proposal for the Glendale International
  Film Festival and respectfully requested sponsorship.
  •  The Commission asked questions, gave their comments and suggestions.
  That the Arts and Culture Commission hereby approves (1) the funding of a proposal for
  Glendale Arts to provide arts programming associated with the Glendale International Film Festival,
  and (2) the sponsorship of the Glendale International Film Festival in an amount not to exceed
  $5,000 from the 2022-2023 Work Plan, as more fully outlined in the August 18, 2022 Report by the
  Library, Arts & Culture’s Principal Arts & Culture Administrator.

  That the Arts and Culture Commission hereby approves (1) the funding of a proposal for Glendale
  Arts to provide arts programming associated with the Glendale International Film Festival, and (2)
  the sponsorship of the Glendale International Film Festival in an amount not to exceed $5,000 from
  the 2022-2023 Work Plan, as more fully outlined in the August 18, 2022 Report by the Library, Arts
  & Culture’s Principal Arts & Culture Administrator.

  Ayes:  Commissioners Tufenkian, Vidor, Vice Chair Viar, Chairperson Yank
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  Commissioner Zadorian
  Abstain:  None

  2. Motion to reconsider previous motion.

  Moved:  Commissioner Vidor
  Seconded: Commissioner Viar

  Ayes:  Commissioners Tufenkian, Vidor, Vice Chair Viar, Chairperson Yank
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  Commissioner Zadorian
  Abstain:  None

  3. Motion to approve (1) the funding of a proposal for the Glendale International Film Festival to
  provide arts programming associated with the Women in Film event as part the Festival, and (2) the
  sponsorship of the Glendale International Film Festival in an amount not to exceed $5,000 from the
  2022-2023 Work Plan.

  Moved:  Commissioner Viar
  Seconded: Commissioner Tufenkian

  That the Arts and Culture Commission hereby approves (1) the funding of a proposal for the
  Glendale International Film Festival to provide arts programming associated with the Women in
  Film event as part the Festival, and (2) the sponsorship of the Glendale International Film Festival
  in an amount not to exceed $5,000 from the 2022-2023 Work Plan.
  2
   Ayes:  Commissioners Tufenkian, Vidor, Vice Chair Viar, Chairperson Yank
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  Commissioner Zadorian
  Abstain:  None

6. DISCUSSION ITEM(s) / REPORT(s)
  a. City-Wide Public Art Landmarks RFQ: Round #2 - LeBasse Projects Update
  b. 2022-2023 Work Plan Progress Updates
  1. CITY-WIDE ARTS
  i.  Art Happens Anywhere
  • Staff is working on a Projects Culmination/Celebration Reception to take place in Fall
  2022 to celebrate the 17 artists and their projects.

  ii.  Mural Ordinance
  •  Staff is working with Ms. Odenkirk on drafting a Mural Ordinance in addition to Policies and
  Procedures which will complement the Mural Ordinance.

  iii.  Creative Crosswalks
  •  On August 8, 2022, Staff released the Creative Crosswalks RFP. The application is
  currently open through September 23, 2022 at 5:00 PM.

  2.  NEIGHBORHOOD ARTS – No Update
  3.  PERFORMING ARTS – No Update
  4.  ARTS AND CULTURAL EVENTS – No Update
  5.  MARKETING AND COMMUNICATIONS
  i.  Public Relations Firm
  • Staff has drafted a Public Relations Firm – Request for Proposals (RFP) for the
  Commission’s review.
  • The Commission asked questions and gave their comments.

7. COMMISSION / STAFF COMMENTS
  •  The Commissioners thanked staff for their work with the Commission.
  •  Commission Vidor stated that Adams Hill will be having its First annual Adams Hills Festival on August
  28th in the Adams Square Mini Park and home studios.
  •  Dr. Shaffer mentioned the art exhibits at the Glendale Library.

8. WRITTEN COMMUNICATIONS- None
9. ADJOURNMENT
The next Regular Meeting of the Arts and Culture Commission is September 15, 2022, at 2:00 p.m., in City
Council Chambers (2nd Floor), 613 E. Broadway.
